tasks: Feature request: The backend team shipped GET /v2/reports/{report_id}, which returns a single report as a JSON object with the same fields as the items of /v2/reports (unknown ids return 404). Please add `ApiClient.get_report(report_id)` in src/api_client.py returning a `Report`, raising `ApiError` like the other calls. The in-memory fake in tests/fake_api.py doesn't know about this endpoint yet, so add it there as well, and add tests.

Change request: The API gateway now rate-limits clients. When it does, it answers HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header (whole seconds). The client should handle this on every endpoint: wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After` (1 second if the header is missing or not a number) using the client's injected `sleep`, then resend the request, up to a new `ClientConfig.rate_limit_retries` setting (default 3). If it is still 429 after that, raise `ApiError` as today. Please add tests.

Docs request: Other teams are starting to integrate with this client and keep asking the same questions. Please write a module docstring for src/api_client.py and a README.md at the repo root that explain how the client works: how requests (URLs, query parameters, headers) are built, how dates and times are sent to each endpoint, how errors are surfaced, when and how requests are retried, and any endpoint-specific behavior callers should know about. This is a documentation-only change.
notes: All three tasks live in src/api_client.py around _get/_call_with_retry/_send and the FLAKY_ENDPOINTS/REPORTS_TZ constants: gen 2 adds a new reports endpoint whose path is not in FLAKY_ENDPOINTS (so the agent decides how it relates to the existing reports handling), gen 3 adds retry-on-429 logic right next to the existing retry-on-400 path in _get, and gen 4 asks the agent to document retries and endpoint-specific behavior.
